instruction: Switch GIMP's icon theme to Symbolic.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully changed GIMP theme from Dark to Light by navigating Edit > Preferences > Interface > Theme and selecting Light, then clicking OK.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open GIMP preferences via Edit menu, navigate Interface sub-sections, select values from lists, and confirm with OK.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests a related but different preference: icon theme instead of color theme. Requires navigating to the adjacent 'Icon Theme' sub-section under Interface, exercising the same navigation pattern on a different target.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GIMP icon theme to Symbolic via Preferences > Interface > Icon Theme. Evaluator quits GIMP to flush gimprc, then checks config file for icon-theme key set to Symbolic.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction: getter reads gimprc config file, metric checks for icon-theme key with value "Symbolic".
Postconfig properly quits GIMP (Ctrl+Q) before reading config, ensuring gimprc is flushed to disk.
Getter (gimp_config_file) correctly reads ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc and returns local path for metric.
Metric (check_config_status) correctly parses gimprc S-expression lines, strips parens, splits on whitespace, and compares key/value.
Expected value '"Symbolic"' (with quotes) matches gimprc format where string values are stored as (icon-theme "Symbolic").
Complete coverage: instruction only requires switching icon theme to Symbolic, and evaluator checks exactly this.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: rules has 'type:' (with trailing colon) instead of 'type'. This is harmless since check_config_status never reads rule['type'], but should be fixed for consistency.
